_note: @mdi/svg's svg/ into files/. The policy only re-serialises ` />` as `/>`. The licence sink writes upstream's Pictogrammers Free License to licenses/mdi-svg/; the Apache-2.0 text it names is hand-supplied in licenses/apache-2.0/, which the sink never writes. The Pictogrammers licence has no standard text, so it is pinned by SHA-256. Reproduces the committed pack byte for byte: a dry run at the pinned version against the local checkout on 2026-11-04 wrote 7,447 SVGs with 0 added, removed or changed.
